# Rotaserie

> Scheduling for independent restaurants and cafés (Washington State first), in English and Spanish. Build next
> week, send it to everyone's phone, and handle swaps, time off and call-outs. Built in Shoreline, Washington, by
> TICO VENTURES LLC. The plain facts are on the [Facts page](https://rotaserie.com/facts.html) (the same as this file).

## What it does
- Type to Build: type the week in plain words, in English or Spanish, and it becomes a schedule you check before saving.
- Setup from a photo of the current schedule: read once; the manager checks it before anything is saved.
- Staff join with a QR code and choose their own password; works in any phone browser, no app store needed.
- Every screen and email in English or Spanish, per person.
- Publishing tells each person what changed for them and shows who hasn't seen the new schedule.
- Quiet hours for new businesses (10 pm to 7 am), except urgent changes to shifts starting soon.
- "I can't make it" from the staff phone; the manager can offer the shift to people who can work it.
- Swaps, pickups, time off and availability.
- Washington rules checked while building: meal breaks, rest between shifts, overtime, minors' hours, minimum wage (helpers, not legal advice).
- Hours and labor cost for the owner, a pay summary to download, an optional time clock.

## What it doesn't do
- No payroll, tip payouts or point-of-sale connection. No GPS tracking.
- No AI building the schedule; the one AI step is reading a setup photo, if the manager chooses it.
- Store apps for iPhone and Android aren't out yet.

## Price
- One price per location, unlimited staff, every feature included. Cancel any time in the app; data downloadable any time.
